llm.reply:
Clinical investigations in non-small cell lung cancer actively examine tyrosine kinase inhibitor protocols, cellular immunotherapies, and central nervous system manifestations across defined receptor alterations [1][4][5]. Multiple genomic sequence variants across the coding sequence are cataloged in SequenceVariant ClinVar:1000076 and SequenceVariant ClinVar:1002380 [6][17]. However, the provided findings specify trial titles rather than current recruitment statuses [1][2][3].

## Clinical Trial Investigations
One registered study is A Retrospective Study of EGFR-TKIs,Gefitinib, Erlotinib and Osimertinib in NSCLC Patients Treatment [1]. Another investigation evaluates targeted intervention under Survival Outcome of EGFR-TKI in Uncommon EGFR Mutant Advanced NSCLC [2]. Monotherapy evaluation is documented in Osimertinib for Advanced EGFR-positive NSCLC Patients [3]. Central nervous system disease monitoring is addressed in CSF Analysis in EGFR Mutant Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer With Leptomeningeal Disease [4].

## Cellular Therapy Approaches
Cellular immunotherapy strategies are actively explored in EGFR/B7H3 CAR-T on Lung Cancer and Triple Negative Breast Cancer [5].

## Receptor Sequence Variations
Specific alterations cataloged in the receptor include the extracellular domain variation NM_005228.5(EGFR):c.840C>A (p.Asn280Lys) [6]. Kinase region alterations include the missense substitution NM_005228.5(EGFR):c.2339T>C (p.Ile780Thr) [17]. A synonymous change in the kinase domain is recorded as NM_005228.5(EGFR):c.2619A>T (p.Gly873=) [16]. A carboxyl-terminal segment alteration is documented as NM_005228.5(EGFR):c.3209G>A (p.Ser1070Asn) [21].

Targeted therapeutics and clinical investigations characterize EGFR-mutant non-small cell lung cancer [1]. Documented studies explore tyrosine kinase inhibitor regimens, central nervous system involvement, and cellular therapies [4][5]. Numerous specific SequenceVariant records delineate alterations within the EGFR locus [6][7].
